nodes.description: ERC20 private mapping(address => uint256) storing token balances; written in _transfer, _mint and _burn.
ERC20 private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) holding spend approvals; written by _approve.
ERC20 private uint256 total token supply; increased in _mint, decreased in _burn.
ERC20 private string token name, set once in the constructor.
ERC20 private string token symbol, set once in the constructor.
GeneratorCopyright private constant string with the generator URL returned by generator().
GeneratorCopyright private string version set in the constructor and read by version().
ERC20 constructor(string name_, string symbol_) initialising _name and _symbol.
ERC20.name() view returning _name.
ERC20.symbol() view returning _symbol.
ERC20.decimals() view returning the constant 18.
ERC20.totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply.
ERC20.balanceOf(address account) view returning _balances[account].
ERC20.transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) external entry point forwarding to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
ERC20.allowance(address owner, address spender) view returning _allowances[owner][spender].
ERC20.approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external entry point calling _approve with _msgSender() as owner.
ERC20.transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) performing _transfer then an unchecked allowance decrement guarded by a require.
ERC20.increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) adding addedValue to the caller's allowance.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) performing a guarded unchecked allowance decrement.
ERC20._transfer internal routine moving balances, invoking hooks and using an unchecked subtraction for the sender balance.
ERC20._mint internal routine increasing _totalSupply and crediting _balances[account].
ERC20._burn internal routine decreasing _balances[account] (unchecked) and _totalSupply.
ERC20._approve internal routine writing _allowances[owner][spender] after zero-address checks.
ERC20._beforeTokenTransfer virtual hook invoked before every transfer, mint and burn.
ERC20._afterTokenTransfer virtual hook invoked after every transfer, mint and burn.
Context._msgSender() internal view returning msg.sender; the caller identity source for all ERC20 entry points.
Context._msgData() internal view returning msg.data.
ServicePayer constructor(address payable receiver, string serviceName) which immediately performs an external payable call to IPayable(receiver).pay.
IPayable.pay(string serviceName) external payable interface function invoked by ServicePayer.
SimpleERC20 payable constructor validating initialBalance_ > 0 and minting the supply to _msgSender().
GeneratorCopyright.generator() pure returning _GENERATOR.
GeneratorCopyright.version() view returning _version.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller identity used for balances, allowances and minting.
msg.value: externally supplied Ether amount forwarded directly to the ServicePayer external call.
External call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) executed in the ServicePayer constructor with an attacker-influenced payable receiver and msg.value.
unchecked { _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount; } in _transfer, guarded by require(senderBalance >= amount).
unchecked allowance decrement in transferFrom via _approve(sender, _msgSender(), currentAllowance - amount).
unchecked { _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount; } in _burn, guarded by require(accountBalance >= amount).
unchecked allowance decrement in decreaseAllowance via _approve(_msgSender(), spender, currentAllowance - subtractedValue).
Checked arithmetic _totalSupply += amount in _mint; a supply inflation primitive.
Checked arithmetic _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue in increaseAllowance.
recipient parameter of transfer/transferFrom, the destination of the moved tokens.
amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom, the quantity moved and subtracted from balances.
sender parameter of transferFrom, the account debited when the caller spends an allowance.
spender parameter of approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance, the approved spender.
owner parameter of allowance/_approve, the account granting the allowance.
account parameter of balanceOf/_mint/_burn.
feeReceiver_ payable address supplied by the deployer and passed as the ServicePayer receiver.
initialBalance_ constructor argument minted to the deployer.
name_ constructor argument for the token name.
symbol_ constructor argument for the token symbol.
serviceName string passed to the ServicePayer external pay call.
local uint256 senderBalance cached from _balances[sender] in _transfer.
local uint256 currentAllowance read from _allowances in transferFrom/decreaseAllowance.
local uint256 accountBalance cached from _balances[account] in _burn.

edges.reason: _msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender to _transfer.
transfer delegates the state change to _transfer.
amount argument flows into transfer and then into the balance arithmetic.
recipient argument flows into transfer as the credit target.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_transfer invokes the _afterTokenTransfer hook.
_beforeTokenTransfer is a virtual hook that can be overridden and re-enter the transfer logic.
_afterTokenTransfer is a virtual hook executing after balance updates and can be overridden.
approve calls _approve with the caller as owner.
_approve writes the _allowances storage mapping.
spender argument flows into the _allowances key.
owner argument flows into the _allowances key.
_mint credits _balances[account].
_mint increases _totalSupply.
SimpleERC20 constructor calls _mint for the initial supply.
The constructor mints to the untrusted msg.sender.
ServicePayer constructor immediately executes the external pay call.
msg.value is forwarded verbatim into the external payable call.
The deployer-supplied payable receiver becomes the external call target.
The external call enters attacker-influenced code at IPayable.pay.
Unchecked subtraction writes the debited _balances entry.
amount is the subtrahend of the unchecked balance subtraction.
The cached senderBalance is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction.
Unchecked subtraction result is written into _allowances through _approve.
currentAllowance read from storage is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom routes the reduced allowance through _approve.
Unchecked subtraction writes the burned _balances entry.
The cached accountBalance is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction.
Unchecked decrease result is written into _allowances.
decreaseAllowance routes the reduced allowance through _approve.
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply.
increaseAllowance adds addedValue to the stored allowance.
_burn reads and writes the _balances mapping.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads _balances.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
name() returns the _name storage string.
symbol() returns the _symbol storage string.
generator() returns the _GENERATOR constant.
version() returns the _version storage string.
ERC20 constructor writes _name.
ERC20 constructor writes _symbol.
transferFrom forwards the sender argument as the debited account.
transferFrom performs the move through _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the allowance through _approve.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender key.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
SimpleERC20 constructor derives the mint recipient from _msgSender().
account argument selects the balance entry destroyed by _burn.
initialBalance_ is the amount minted by the SimpleERC20 constructor.
name_ is assigned to _name by the ERC20 constructor.
symbol_ is assigned to _symbol by the ERC20 constructor.
serviceName is forwarded to the ServicePayer external call.
feeReceiver_ is used as the payable receiver cast to IPayable.
msg.value is forwarded through the ServicePayer constructor to the external callee.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_mint invokes the _afterTokenTransfer hook.
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_burn invokes the _afterTokenTransfer hook.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only an argument of ERC20.transfer and does not need an independent node in the security graph.
amount belongs to ERC20.transfer which derives the balance arithmetic from it.
sender is a parameter of transferFrom consumed by ERC20._transfer.
spender is only consumed as an _allowances key inside ERC20._approve.
owner is only consumed as an _allowances key inside ERC20._approve.
account selects the balance entry modified by ERC20._burn.
feeReceiver_ is the receiver address of the external pay call represented by the unsafe operation.
initialBalance_ is the mint amount of the SimpleERC20 constructor.
name_ is consumed by the ERC20 constructor to initialise _name.
symbol_ is consumed by the ERC20 constructor to initialise _symbol.
serviceName is only forwarded by the ServicePayer constructor call.
senderBalance is the transient minuend of the unchecked balance subtraction in _transfer.
currentAllowance is the transient minuend of the unchecked allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
accountBalance is the transient minuend of the unchecked burn subtraction in _burn.
